info.name: compareSets API Tests
info.description:
Test suite for the compareSets Lambda function covering legacy eval/preview and muEd API paths.

## Setup
Set `baseUrl` to:
- **Local (Lambda RIE):** `http://localhost:9001/2015-03-31/functions/function/invocations`
- **Staging/Prod (API Gateway):** your deployed API Gateway URL

## Helper architecture
The collection pre-request stores shared builder functions in `pm.globals.__helpers`. Each request pre-request calls `eval(pm.globals.get('__helpers'))` and then uses `setLegacyEvalReq`, `setLegacyPreviewReq`, or `setMuEdEvalReq`. Three shared test cases (`tc_simple_correct`, `tc_simple_incorrect`, `tc_commutative`) are stored as collection variables and referenced by both Legacy and muEd folders.

variable.description: Change to your API Gateway URL for staging/prod testing
Set to 'local' for Lambda RIE or 'cloud' for API Gateway

// Shared test cases — referenced by Legacy and muEd folders

pm.collectionVariables.set('tc_simple_incorrect', JSON.stringify({response:'A n B', answer:'A u B', params:{}}));
pm.collectionVariables.set('tc_commutative',      JSON.stringify({response:'B n A', answer:'A n B', params:{}}));

pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Correct: intersection commutative (A n B = B n A)
Correct: union commutative (A u B = B u A)
Correct: intersection commutative (A n B = B n A)

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Correct: union commutative (A u B = B u A)

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Correct: (A u B)' = A' n B' (first law)
Correct: (A n B)' = A' u B' (second law)
Correct: (A u B)' = A' n B' (first law)

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Correct: (A n B)' = A' u B' (second law)

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Correct: union with complement (B' u B = A u A')

exec: pm.test('is_correct is true (both equal universal set)', function () { pm.expect(r.result.is_correct).to.be.true; });

item.name: Correct: intersection with complement (B' n B = A n A')

exec: pm.test('is_correct is true (both equal empty set)', function () { pm.expect(r.result.is_correct).to.be.true; });

item.name: Correct: union with complement (B' u B = A u A')

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('awardedPoints equals 1 (both equal universal set)', function () { pm.expect(r[0].awardedPoints).to.equal(1); });

item.name: Correct: intersection with complement (B' n B = A n A')

exec: pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('awardedPoints equals 1 (both equal empty set)', function () { pm.expect(r[0].awardedPoints).to.equal(1); });

item.name: Correct: commutativity with enforce=true (SymPy normalises A u B = B u A)

exec: setLegacyEvalReq('A u B', 'B u A', {enforce_expression_equality: true});
pm.test('is_correct is true (SymPy normalises commuted union)', function () { pm.expect(r.result.is_correct).to.be.true; });

item.name: Incorrect: De Morgan with enforce=true ((A u B)' ≠ A' n B' syntactically)

exec: setLegacyEvalReq("(A u B)'", "A' n B'", {enforce_expression_equality: true});
pm.test('is_correct is false (syntactically different despite semantic equality)', function () { pm.expect(r.result.is_correct).to.be.false; });

item.name: Correct: commutativity with enforce=true (SymPy normalises A u B = B u A)

exec: setMuEdEvalReq('A u B', 'B u A', {enforce_expression_equality: true});
pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('awardedPoints equals 1 (SymPy normalises commuted union)', function () { pm.expect(r[0].awardedPoints).to.equal(1); });

item.name: Incorrect: De Morgan with enforce=true ((A u B)' ≠ A' n B' syntactically)

exec: setMuEdEvalReq("(A u B)'", "A' n B'", {enforce_expression_equality: true});
pm.test('response is an array', function () { pm.expect(r).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('awardedPoints equals 0 (syntactically different despite semantic equality)', function () { pm.expect(r[0].awardedPoints).to.equal(0); });

item.name: Correct: LaTeX intersection (A \cap B = A n B)

exec: pm.test('response_latex equals A \\cap B', function () { pm.expect(r.result.response_latex).to.equal('A \\cap B'); });

item.name: Correct: LaTeX union (A \cup B = A u B)

exec: pm.test('response_latex equals A \\cup B', function () { pm.expect(r.result.response_latex).to.equal('A \\cup B'); });
